In Episode 61 of The Informed Investor podcast: A deep dive on this year’s index reconstitutions and how investors can surmount the hidden costs. KEY TAKEAWAYS Index funds have low fees, but not necessarily low costs. A better option may be a diversified strategy that looks to rebalance every day.  VIEW ALL EPISODES ON YOUTUBE
